purpose: Materialize and validate Coolify's actual Raw Compose without starting PIT containers
allowedPreparation: Operator imports the four existing PIT-only private values into the new Application without disclosing them
Verify Raw mode, manual deployment, no domain, no preview deployment, no predefined network
Verify the custom start command is docker compose config --quiet
Run one Coolify job with that non-starting custom command solely to materialize its actual Compose
Read and validate the generated Compose privately without printing secret values
Inspect the new Application management network and confirm it contains no PIT container
anticipatedCoolifySideEffects: Coolify may clone the pinned Git source and pull the pinned images
Coolify may create an empty Application management network and attach coolify-proxy to it
Coolify may create deployment records and temporary files
prohibited: docker compose up or any PIT container startup
public ports, domains or Traefik routers
starting, deleting or attaching the old PIT Service or its volume
modifying shared proxy configuration or neighboring applications
Cloudflare changes, payments, signing or blockchain writes
stopCondition: If any PIT container starts or any PIT data or RPC network becomes proxy-accessible, stop the new PIT-only resources and preserve all volumes
acceptance: Generated Compose is captured with 0600 permissions, rendered privately and passes check-coolify-raw-canary.mjs for the Application UUID; effective volume name and network topology are recorded; no PIT service has started
subsequentGate: A separate final manifest and GO PIT INTERNAL CANARY RAW authorization are required before starting any PIT container
